bagPolicy.summary: Scotiabank Arena enforces a restricted bag policy allowing only small purses, clutches, or fanny packs smaller than 16.5cm x 11.5cm. Bags not meeting this requirement may be subject to x-ray inspection.
allowed: fanny pack type bags smaller than 16.5cm x 11.5cm
bagPolicy.note: Bags required for medical reasons may be permitted subject to x-ray inspection.

parking.note: Scotiabank Arena offers two levels of parking for private suite holders and office tenants, with a flat fee of $50. Accessible parking is limited and requires advance booking. Public parking is available nearby at 15 York Street with indoor access to the arena.
lots: Underground Public Parking at 15 York Street

rideshare.note: For accessible pickup and drop-off by Wheel-Trans or private vehicle, use the Bremner Boulevard traffic loop by Gates 5 and 6 on the west side. The loop can be congested or closed to vehicles other than Wheel-Trans.

concessions.note: Scotiabank Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including gourmet hot dogs, sushi, poutine, and classic burgers. Specialty bars serve premium spirits and cocktails, enhancing the game or concert experience.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Fully ADA accessible. Wheelchair seating, elevators, and accessible services throughout.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office on Bay Street. Government-issued photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Main entrance on Bay Street. Connected to Union Station via underground PATH walkway.
